stem: At Fenwick Freight, two run tasks are attached to a workspace at the post-plan stage: a cost scanner set to advisory and a security scanner set to mandatory. Both report failure for the same run. What is the outcome?

choices.text: The run completes with both failures shown only as warnings
The run pauses until a user with the Manage Policy Overrides permission overrides it
The run is blocked only when every attached task is set to mandatory
The mandatory task blocks the run from completing

rationale: When several run tasks are attached, the run ends based on the most restrictive enforcement level among them. A failed mandatory run task can block a run from completing, so the mandatory scanner's failure blocks it even though the advisory task alone could not. Treating both as warnings ignores the most-restrictive rule. The override permission belongs to policy enforcement, and run tasks have their own advisory and mandatory levels that are not the policy levels. Requiring every task to be mandatory is not the rule; one mandatory failure is enough.
